# Validator selection commission and MEV tip sharing — facts

## How it works

- [statement] In the jito-tip-distribution program, initialize_tip_distribution_account stores validator_commission_bps and rejects values above the config's max_validator_commission_bps (MaxValidatorCommissionFeeBpsExceeded). The shown source never computes the split: claim pays whatever amount a merkle proof verifies against the root that the merkle_root_upload_authority uploaded, so the staker/validator split is fixed off-chain when the tree is built (TipRouter operators reach consensus on each epoch's distribution). (medium confidence) — https://docs.rs/jito-tip-distribution/latest/src/jito_tip_distribution/lib.rs.html · keywords: Validator selection commission and MEV tip sharing · also: https://buffalu.substack.com/p/tiprouter-and-the-future-of-solana

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Since SIMD-0096 went live in early 2025, the leader keeps 100% of priority fees. No protocol rule passes them to stakers, so any sharing is voluntary and outside the core protocol. Jito tips were the one reward stream already shared through a distribution program. In Jan 2025 a Jito-side author (Lucas Bruder) estimated that tips raised staking rewards 25-50% in recent epochs, with more than $950M distributed to date. (high confidence) — https://solanacompass.com/staking/how-does-solana-staking-work · keywords: Validator selection commission and MEV tip sharing · also: https://buffalu.substack.com/p/tiprouter-and-the-future-of-solana, https://forum.jito.network/t/jip-16-tiprouter-and-stakenet-adjustments-for-priority-fees/640
